newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse closes lower as worries return.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse closes lower as worries return.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange ended flat for the second straight session on Wednesday as pre-election caution and general economic worries returned to haunt the market after a brief rebound last week, traders said.
The All-Share Index dropped 0.20 points to 367.96. Volume at 17,070 shares was better than Monday's 13,990 but small overall by the bourse's standards.
A total one billion shares were on offer compared with bids of 643,640 shares. -- Abidjan newsroom: +225 21 90 90
